name: Kalshi
description: Kalshi is a CFTC-regulated prediction market platform for trading event contracts on real-world outcomes in politics, economics, technology, and more. It aggregates crowd wisdom into probability prices and serves as a live benchmark (e.g., KalshiBench) for AI forecasting and epistemic calibration.
reputation: Leading regulated prediction market increasingly used as a rigorous benchmark for LLM uncertainty quantification and real-world forecasting.
notes: Real-money incentives create strong signal; provides verifiable post-cutoff outcomes ideal for testing models on unknown future events.
